task: HuC6280 Synth shared normal/Code/VGM channel view and heard-position Live settings
behavior: One always-visible Synth/CH1–CH6 selector controls normal, Code and VGM views. Synth is the default, Auto update starts On, and changing the selection alone never copies values between channels.

Normal physical channels have independent current wave, level, pan, Noise, software envelope and DDA playback settings. Keyboard notes use that physical channel; Stop/blur release voices while retaining the session bank. Common author preset stays unchanged. Common scalar/wave edits broadcast only touched fields; explicit loads or source/routing/sample changes reset the bank.

The normal session bank is not a new file format. Code start/Stop intentionally restore the common authored instrument; existing Code physical edits keep their sparse touched-author-field contract. Selecting a channel before audio is enabled is passive.

Passive song timeline hooks preserve native PCM exactly, including direct DAC and streams. They track sent registers/configured Wave RAM at generated-frame boundaries and publish the consumed/heard state rather than prefetched values. Pending changes are bounded and coalesced by field/frame/channel; observation failure disables only Live.

VGM physical CH views reuse the existing source, wave, level/pan, Noise and shared LFO UI read-only. Card folding and Main/LFO target selection remain usable. Unknown registers show unknown markers, incomplete Wave RAM stays blank, and DDA shows the last recorded five-bit DAC code without borrowing author PCM or guessing a root note.

Physical period labels describe current registers; common Synth keeps its C4-reference labels. Readouts include Gate, period/frequency or Noise/DAC state, per-channel level/pan and shared global L/R balance.

Auto Off retains a full-chip snapshot for consistent CH switching; On follows the heard position. Periodic publication is at most 20 Hz. Pause/EOF explicitly publish the final consumed state even when Auto Off. Passive tracking still advances to bound memory and permit catchup.

VGM CH views block edits and keyboard audition in this phase. Synth view can play the authored instrument while paused. Stop/source/context transitions clear the song view. Selected-song-CH audition/Capture, CH mute, Seek and direct VGM editing remain separate next steps.
Native testing confirmed Noise takes priority when Noise and DDA bits are both set. Code and hand note paths now follow that priority without requiring an unrelated PCM asset.

Standalone packaging preserves readable byte-identical source modules, types, source archives, rebuild sources and licenses. Existing native WASM, gain calibration, Master and desktop output graph are unchanged.
ci: The HuC6280 workflow now runs the new muted Live checker sequentially with legacy, Code and song checks on the extracted standalone ZIP. GitHub Actions was not dispatched.
scope: No physical listening, user storage changes, commercial game assets, commit, push, tag, publication, Tauri update or public npm API change. Normal multi-channel settings are temporary and are not saved as a bank. VGM view is read-only; its CH keyboard audition and Capture remain pending.
